item.name: ash-text
item.summary: headline: One line of real text drawn as grains of ash; a click or its button blows it away with glowing edges and it gathers back (canvas 2D, server-safe text)

useWhen: One short word or line that deserves a moment (a hero word, a 404, a closing line)
Brand pages about fire, time or impermanence
avoidWhen: Body copy, long or wrapping text (it is one line)
Text that must stay crisp at all times (labels, navigation)

alternatives.name: text-reveal
alternatives.when: When the text should arrive once, word by word

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The real text, as it is in the server HTML: no grains, no canvas, no button.

input.pointer: Click the word to blow it away from that point; hovering nudges the grains
input.keyboard: A native button under the word ("Blow … away") does the same

a11y.notes: The text stays in the DOM as a real heading or paragraph (`as`), transparent only while the grains are drawn in its own colour. The effect is one gust of about 4 s, started by the visitor. The canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: as
props.effect: The element the text is rendered as.

props.name: interactive
props.effect: Offer the click and the button; false keeps it as a still texture.

props.name: actionLabel
props.effect: Name of the button (default: Blow "<text>" away).

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Pass plain text (a string), one line: it is drawn grain by grain.
Set the font on AshText itself (style or className); the text element inherits it.
The grains fly up to 200 px around the word: do not clip the parent with overflow: hidden.
verify: Server HTML has the text as a real heading.
The button blows the word away and it gathers back within about 4 s.
